title: Endocrine Outcome of Surgery for Pituitary Adenoma
brief_summary: Prospective and randomized compare between microsurgical and endoscopic transsphenoidal MRI assisted resection of pituitary adenomas.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected symptomatic or progressively growing pituitary adenoma
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prolactinoma
* No follow-up possible
* Emergency surgery without informed consent or without intraoperative MRI
